This is my only plot and my family must eat from it, so I will put my best effort into the maize. I hope to get the FISP coupon again this year for a bag of NPK and a bag of urea — if not, I will still try to buy at least one bag, because without fertilizer the yield is too poor on our tired soil here in Balaka. I will add the manure from our few chickens and goats to stretch the fertilizer, and plant hybrid seed if the coupon comes through. I cannot afford pesticides or irrigation; I will rely on the rains and my own hands, with maybe a few days of ganyu help for ridging if my back troubles me.
